official_baseline_claims.claim: Live GitHub release metadata identifies v1.18.1, published 2026-09-21, as the latest release; its tagged source is 80b4280a9196feace092fc672dfe2b5fac62ef08.

The README offers `npx repomix@latest` for a one-off run and an npm global installation for repeat use (https://github.com/yamadashy/repomix/blob/v1.18.1/README.md#quick-start); the pinned package requires Node.js >=22.0.0.
Repomix packages repository content for AI consumption, with explicit include/ignore selection and XML, Markdown, JSON or plain output. Its counters describe the packed representation.
Tree-sitter compression is advertised as preserving function/method signatures, classes and types while removing implementation details; the compression guide labels this feature experimental.
The MCP surface supports packing followed by selective searching and reading. Its README recommends incremental retrieval and says compression is generally unnecessary for that workflow.

The current release already contains the repository-local Git-helper execution fix and fixes for Windows ignore handling, comment removal and split-output directory trees; these are benefits already present in the pin.

limitations.text: Compression intentionally removes implementation detail, so it is lossy. The checked compression guide and README do not warn specifically that Python multiline signatures can disappear; the guide instead lists function and method signatures among preserved structures.

Confirmed source defect at the pinned commit: PythonParseStrategy.getFunctionSignature reads only lines[startRow] and requires the closing parenthesis and colon on that same line (lines 81-85). parseFunctionDefinition returns a null result when that match fails (lines 100-106), causing multiline Python function and method definitions to be omitted.

Open issue #1876 documents wildcard-ending built-in ignore patterns failing to exclude previous packs and logs. The report was made against an earlier release; the current main comparison contains no source fix for this path (https://github.com/yamadashy/repomix/compare/v1.18.1...75f9f860548c10f955e4730f7961947780104443).
Open issue #1874 reports failed packs with empty diagnostics under --quiet or stdout output. Empty output is not a success signal; consumers need the actual exit status and a fresh artifact.

The MCP server can normally access paths available to its process. Upstream's optional --sandbox confines its tool surface to a workspace and disables remote packing and other escaping operations; this is application-level confinement, not an operating-system sandbox.

new_since_pin.text: No newer published release was present in the live release list; v1.18.1 remains latest.
